verses.text: Watch ye therefore, because ye know not what hour your Lord will come.
verses.note: Advent begins with watching: be ready, because the hour of the Lord's coming is not known.

verses.text: The voice of one crying in the desert: Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the wilderness the paths of our God.
verses.note: The prophet Isaiah hears a voice calling us to prepare the way of the Lord.

verses.text: The people that walked in darkness, have seen a great light: to them that dwelt in the region of the shadow of death, light is risen.
verses.note: Isaiah promises a great light to a people who walk in darkness.

verses.text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the root of Jesse, and a flower shall rise up out of his root.
verses.note: Isaiah foretells a rod out of the root of Jesse, the father of King David.

verses.text: Rejoice in the Lord always; again, I say, rejoice.
verses.note: The rose candle of the third week is a call to joy: rejoice in the Lord always.

verses.text: Arise, be enlightened, O Jerusalem: for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.
verses.note: Isaiah calls Jerusalem to arise, for her light has come.

verses.text: Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, in which the Orient from on high hath visited us: To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: to direct our feet into the way of peace.
verses.note: Zechariah sings that the Orient from on high has visited us, to enlighten those who sit in darkness.

verses.text: But unto you that fear my name, the Sun of justice shall arise, and health in his wings: and you shall go forth, and shall leap like calves of the herd.
verses.note: Malachi promises that the Sun of justice will arise, with health in his wings, for those who fear the Lord's name.

verses.text: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light.
verses.note: Paul tells the Romans that the night is passed and the day is at hand.

verses.text: But when these things begin to come to pass, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is at hand.
verses.note: Jesus tells his followers to lift up their heads, because their redemption is at hand.

verses.text: And the light shineth in darkness, and the darkness did not comprehend it.
verses.note: John's Gospel says the light shines in the darkness.

verses.text: He that giveth testimony of these things, saith, Surely I come quickly: Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
verses.note: Among the Bible's last words is a prayer for his coming: Come, Lord Jesus.
